title: Finite etale descent from a punctured root splitting
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $g\in R$, and $n>0$ an integer invertible in $R$. Put $U=D(g)\subset\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $j:Y\to U$ be a morphism and $p=j\circ\iota_U$. Put $A=R[T]/(T^n-g)$ and $V=D(g)\subset\operatorname{Spec}A$. Suppose $d\in\mathbb N$ and there is an isomorphism $Y\times_{\operatorname{Spec}R}V\cong\coprod_{\operatorname{Fin}d}V$ [def-pc-fibre-product] whose composite with the fold is the second projection. Then $j$ is finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] and etale [def-weil-etale-morphism].

source.place: Tags 02LA and 02VN, finite and etale fpqc descent applied to the punctured root cover in Tag 0EYG

proof.text: Construct w:V -> U by IsOpenImmersion.lift: membership in D(algebraMap(g)) implies membership of the image in D(g). The lift satisfies w followed by U.ι = V.ι followed by q. Apply lem-sbc-root-split-away-cover-etale and Etale.of_comp to show w etale, hence flat.

For each point y of U, apply lem-sbc-root-split-away-cover-point to its underlying prime and g not in that prime. The lifted point maps to y under w because U.ι is injective. Both basic opens U and V are affine (IsAffineOpen.Spec_basicOpen), so w is quasi-compact. Thus w is surjective, flat and quasi-compact; no finiteness assertion for w is required.

Use PullbackCone.isLimitOfFactors with the monomorphism U.ι and the identities hj and hw to identify the supplied pullback over Spec R as a pullback of j and w. The equation hdelta transports its second projection to delta.hom followed by the finite coproduct fold. IsFinite.sigmaDesc and IsZariskiLocalAtSource.sigmaDesc show that this fold is finite and etale respectively; isomorphism composition preserves both. This includes d=0.

Apply the source library theorem IsFinite.descendsAlong_surjective_inf_flat_inf_quasicompact (Stacks 02LA) and the Mathlib LocalFlatDescent instance for Etale (Stacks 02VN) to the flipped pullback square. Both properties of the second projection descend to j via MorphismProperty.of_isPullback_of_descendsAlong.

proof_origin.note: Complete Lean assembly from the existing proved punctured-root etaleness and point-lifting theorems, finite coproduct stability and fpqc descent. Quasi-compactness follows from affine basic opens; finiteness of the descent cover is unnecessary.

theorem root_split_factor_finite_etale
    (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (g : R) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n ∧ IsUnit (n : R))
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : Y ⟶ Spec R)
    (j : Y ⟶ Scheme.Opens.toScheme (X := Spec R) (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g))
    (hj : j ≫ Scheme.Opens.ι (X := Spec R) (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g) = p)
    (d : ℕ) :
    let A := AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial R) ^ n - Polynomial.C g)
    let N := Spec (CommRingCat.of A)
    let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A))
    let V : N.Opens := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap R A g)
    ∀ (δ : pullback p (V.ι ≫ q) ≅ ∐ fun _ : Fin d ↦ V.toScheme),
      δ.hom ≫ Sigma.desc (fun _ : Fin d ↦ 𝟙 V.toScheme) =
        pullback.snd p (V.ι ≫ q) →
    IsFinite j ∧ Etale j
